Mr. Pett , who was touchy on the subject

308.text: a fourteen - year - old boy of a singularly unloveable type

quotes.text: "Come in, pop, come in. Lots of room."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "I wish you would not eat candy all day."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "Got a grouch this morning, haven't you, pop?"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "I will not be spoken to like that!"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"I can
always tell. I don't see why you want to come picking on me,
though. I've done nothing."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "There are two butts in the ash-tray."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "You dropped it there when you heard me come in."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"No, sir! I've only been here a few minutes. I guess one of the
fellows was in here before me. They're always swiping your
coffin-nails. You ought to do something about it, pop. You ought
to assert yourself."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "You ought to be out in the open air this lovely morning,"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "All right. Let's go for a walk. I will if you will."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"Well, this fresh-air stuff is overrated anyway. Where's the
sense of having a home if you don't stop in it?"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"When I was your age, I would have been out on a morning like
this--er--bowling my hoop."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "I am not a martyr to lumbago,"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "Have it your own way. All I know is--"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "Quite right. Got to be careful at your age."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"Getting on, you know. Not so young as you used to be. Come in,
pop, if you're coming in. There's a draft from that door."
quotes.speaker: Unknown
